|translation='''Title:''' Medium Transport.

'''Card text:'''
May carry 1 pilot, 4 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Treat deploy and move like a starfighter. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:'''
A personnel and cargo transport built by Gallofree Yards. Its huge cargo bays can, depending on outfitting, hold many troops, munitions, and supplies.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 大型艦：輸送艇.
